test_cases.title: Registered user receives a valid reset link valid for 30 minutes
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user receives a valid reset link valid for 30 minutes.
preconditions: A user is registered with a valid email address.
The system has a working password reset flow.

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a form to enter the email address.

steps.action: User enters their registered email address and submits the form.
steps.expected_result: The system sends a password reset link to the email address.

steps.action: User checks their email within 30 minutes after submission.
steps.expected_result: The email contains a valid reset link that is functional and valid for 3-30 minutes.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

test_cases.title: Unregistered email receives visible confirmation but no reset email is sent
test_cases.objective: Verify that an unregistered email receives a visible confirmation but no reset email is sent.
preconditions: An unregistered email address is entered in the password reset form.
The system has a mechanism to validate email registration status.

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a form to enter the email address.

steps.action: User enters an unregistered email address and submits the form.
steps.expected_result: The system displays a visible confirmation message (e.g., 'We have sent a reset link to your email') without sending an email.

steps.action: User checks their inbox after submission.
steps.expected_result: No email is found from the system for the unregistered address.

source_requirements: An unregistered email address receives the same visible confirmation, but no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset link can be used only once
test_cases.objective: Verify that a reset link can be used only once.
preconditions: A registered user has successfully received a reset link.
The reset link is still valid (within 30 minutes of issuance).

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page and enters their email.
steps.expected_result: The system sends a reset link to the email address.

steps.action: User opens the reset link in a browser and enters a new password.
steps.expected_result: The system successfully updates the password and redirects to the login page.

steps.action: User attempts to use the same reset link again (e.g., by refreshing or re-clicking).
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the link is invalid or expired.

source_requirements: A reset link can be used only once.

test_cases.title: New password must satisfy configured password policy
test_cases.objective: Verify that the password policy is enforced when setting a new password.
preconditions: A registered user has received a reset link and is on the password reset page.
The system has a configured password policy (e.g., minimum length, character requirements).

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link and enters their email.
steps.expected_result: The system sends a reset link to the email address.

steps.action: User opens the reset link and enters a new password that does not meet the policy (e.g., 6 characters, no special character).
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the password and displays an error message indicating it does not meet the policy.

steps.action: User enters a new password that satisfies the policy (e.g., 8 characters, includes uppercase, lowercase, number, special character).
steps.expected_result: The system accepts the password and updates the account.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the configured password policy.

test_cases.title: Invalid email input results in visible error message
test_cases.objective: Verify that invalid email input results in a visible error message.
preconditions: The password reset form is accessible.
The system validates email format on input.

steps.action: User clicks the 'Forgot Password' link and enters an invalid email (e.g., 'invalid-email').
steps.expected_result: The system displays a visible error message indicating the email is invalid.

steps.action: User submits the form with invalid email.
steps.expected_result: The system does not send any email and displays an error message.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.
An unregistered email address receives the same visible confirmation, but no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes of issuance
test_cases.objective: Verify that the reset link expires after 30 minutes, even if used late.
preconditions: A registered user has received a reset link at exactly 10:00 AM.
The system enforces a 30-minute validity window for reset links.

steps.action: User receives a reset link at 10:00 AM and opens it at 10:31 AM.
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the link has expired.

steps.action: User attempts to use the link after 31 minutes of issuance.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the link and does not allow password reset.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.
